label: gateway-health
info:
Gateway Health Reporting Flow (FR5, FR50)

Collects system metrics from Netdata HTTP API and publishes health telemetry directly to ThingsBoard cloud every 30 seconds.

Inputs:
- Netdata HTTP API (http://netdata:19999) — CPU, RAM, disk, uptime
- nexus/internal/cloud-connection-status — cloud connectivity state (from Story 1.4)
- nexus/internal/buffer-status — buffer state (from Story 1.5)
- nexus/internal/iec104-status — IEC104 connection state (from Story 2.1)

Outputs:
- v1/devices/me/telemetry on ThingsBoard Cloud — health telemetry (direct to cloud, bypasses local pipeline)
- nexus/internal/gateway-health-status on Local Mosquitto — local health summary
- nexus/internal/gateway-health-errors on Local Mosquitto — error reporting

Health telemetry keys (8):
cpu_usage_pct, ram_usage_pct, disk_usage_pct, uptime_seconds,
mqtt_connected, cloud_connected, buffer_queue_size, buffering_active,
iec104_connected

During cloud outage, health telemetry is silently dropped (not buffered).
Fresh data published immediately on reconnection.

name: Flow: gateway-health (FR5, NFR2, NFR4)
info:
Gateway Health Reporting Flow

Purpose: Collect edge gateway system metrics and publish as health telemetry to ThingsBoard cloud.

Metrics collected from Netdata HTTP API:
- CPU usage (system.cpu)
- RAM usage (system.ram)
- Disk usage (disk_space./)
- System uptime (system.uptime)

Internal status from MQTT:
- cloud_connected from nexus/internal/cloud-connection-status
- buffer_queue_size, buffering_active from nexus/internal/buffer-status
- iec104_connected from nexus/internal/iec104-status
- mqtt_connected: always true (flow running = MQTT works)

Publishing:
- DIRECT to ThingsBoard cloud broker (bypasses nexus/+/+/telemetry pipeline)
- Also publishes to nexus/internal/gateway-health-status for local consumption

Error handling: catch node logs all errors in format:
[gateway-health] {error_type}: {message}
